How often does the L.A. Times 101 list make room for a first-timer? Every edition since 2013 is here. Pick a year to see who made their debut, who came back, and who stayed on.

<style>

## How I counted

I compared all 101 published entries in each edition with the complete history up to that year. An entry is a **first appearance** if it has no earlier match, a **comeback** if its latest match was more than a year earlier, and a **previous edition** pick if it appeared the year before.

I matched spelling changes, moves and relaunches of the same restaurant. A separately reviewed branch can debut on its own, as Badmaash Venice did in 2026. A grouped entry takes up one slot and can establish an appearance for its co-featured restaurants. For example, the 2025 Mercado La Paloma entry keeps Holbox and Komal in the running going into 2026. Mentions in broader market write-ups and the separate Hall of Fame are excluded. The 2020 edition used nine slots for profiles of people and organizations, shown as other honorees.

The [Times’ 2018 roundup](https://www.latimes.com/food/dailydish/la-fo-re-new-101-list-20181205-story.html) highlighted 31 debuts. This tracker counts 28 new slots that year. Bar Amá and Somni appeared in shared slots with previously listed restaurants, and Jon & Vinny’s had already appeared in 2015.

Sources are the [L.A. Times archive of annual lists](https://www.latimes.com/food/story/2024-12-03/101-best-los-angeles-restaurants-since-2013-jonathan-gold-bill-addison) and the original edition linked for each year.

```{r la101-data, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
edition_json <- paste(readLines("data/la_times_101.json", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
cat('<script type="application/json" id="la101-data">\n',
    gsub("<", "\\u003c", edition_json, fixed = TRUE), '\n</script>\n', sep = "")
```

<script>
(() => {
  const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("la101-data").textContent);
  const years = Object.keys(data).reverse();
  const chart = document.getElementById("la101-chart");
  const year = document.getElementById("la101-year");
  const status = document.getElementById("la101-status");
  const query = document.getElementById("la101-query");
  const summary = document.getElementById("la101-summary");
  const source = document.getElementById("la101-source");
  const entries = document.getElementById("la101-entries");
  const historyQuery = document.getElementById("la101-history-query");
  const historySummary = document.getElementById("la101-history-summary");
  const historyEntries = document.getElementById("la101-history-entries");

  function element(tag, text) {
    const node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
    return node;
  }

  function searchKey(text) {
    return text.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase();
  }

  function buildHistory() {
    const restaurants = new Map();
    const standaloneByYear = new Map();
    for (const [edition, { rows }] of Object.entries(data)) {
      const standalone = new Map();
      standaloneByYear.set(Number(edition), standalone);
      for (const row of rows) {
        if (row.status === "Other") continue;
        const names = (row.note || row.name).split(" / ");
        const isStandalone = names.length === 1;
        // Follow prior names for the same restaurant without merging the members of a shared slot.
        const previousKey = isStandalone && standaloneByYear.get(row.previous)?.get(row.match);
        for (const name of names) {
          const key = previousKey || searchKey(name).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
          if (!restaurants.has(key)) {
            restaurants.set(key, { name, aliases: new Set(), editions: new Set() });
          }
          const restaurant = restaurants.get(key);
          restaurant.editions.add(edition);
          restaurant.aliases.add(name);
          restaurant.aliases.add(row.name);
          if (isStandalone) {
            restaurant.name = name;
            standalone.set(row.name, key);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return Array.from(restaurants.values()).sort((a, b) =>
      b.editions.size - a.editions.size || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "en")
    );
  }

  const history = buildHistory();

  function renderHistory() {
    const needle = searchKey(historyQuery.value.trim());
    const visible = history.filter(restaurant =>
      Array.from(restaurant.aliases).some(name => searchKey(name).includes(needle))
    );
    const rows = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (const restaurant of visible) {
      const tr = element("tr");
      const label = element("th", restaurant.name);
      label.scope = "row";
      tr.append(label, element("td", `${restaurant.editions.size} / ${years.length}`),
        element("td", Array.from(restaurant.editions).join(", ")));
      rows.append(tr);
    }
    historyEntries.replaceChildren(rows);
    historySummary.textContent = `Showing ${visible.length} of ${history.length} entries.`;
  }

  function renderEdition() {
    const { source: url, rows, counts } = data[year.value];
    const needle = searchKey(query.value.trim());
    const visible = rows.filter(row =>
      (!status.value || row.status === status.value) &&
      searchKey([row.name, row.note, row.match].join(" ")).includes(needle)
    );
    source.href = url;
    const [debut, comeback, previous, other] = counts;
    const otherText = other ? `, ${other} other honoree slots` : "";
    summary.textContent = `${year.value} · ${debut} first appearances, ${comeback} comebacks, ${previous} from the previous edition${otherText}. Showing ${visible.length} of ${rows.length} entries.`;
    entries.replaceChildren();
    for (const row of visible) {
      const tr = element("tr");
      const label = element("th", row.name);
      label.scope = "row";
      tr.append(label, element("td", row.status === "Other" ? "Other honoree" : row.status),
        element("td", row.first ?? "—"), element("td", row.previous ?? "—"));
      if (row.match && row.match !== row.name) {
        tr.lastElementChild.append(element("small", ` · ${row.match}`));
      }
      entries.append(tr);
    }
    for (const button of chart.children) {
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", button.dataset.year === year.value);
    }
  }

  for (const edition of years) {
    const isTransition = edition === "2018";
    const label = isTransition ? "2018*" : edition;
    const option = element("option", label);
    option.value = edition;
    year.append(option);
    const { counts } = data[edition];
    const [debut, comeback, previous, other] = counts;
    const button = element("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.className = "edition-button";
    button.dataset.year = edition;
    if (isTransition) button.setAttribute("aria-describedby", "la101-2018-note");
    button.setAttribute("aria-label", `${edition}, ${debut} first appearances, ${comeback} comebacks, ${previous} from the previous edition, ${other} other honoree slots`);
    const bar = element("span");
    bar.className = "edition-bar";
    bar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    ["debut", "return", "repeat", "other"].forEach((className, index) => {
      const segment = element("span");
      segment.className = className;
      segment.style.flexGrow = counts[index];
      bar.append(segment);
    });
    button.append(element("strong", label), bar, element("span", `${debut} new · ${comeback} back`));
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      year.value = edition;
      renderEdition();
    });
    chart.append(button);
  }
  year.addEventListener("change", renderEdition);
  status.addEventListener("change", renderEdition);
  query.addEventListener("input", renderEdition);
  historyQuery.addEventListener("input", renderHistory);
  renderHistory();
  renderEdition();
})();
</script>
